import sys as _mbsys; _mbsys.path.insert(0, 'C:\\Users\\Nanja\\MachineBench\\machinebench\\bridge'); import mb_cam as mb
import json

# Identify pocket-relevant faces
print("=== POCKET FACES ANALYSIS ===")
faces = mb.faces(0, kind=None)

# Floor face (facing up at z=30)
floor_face = [f for f in faces if f['index']==5][0]
print(f"Pocket floor: idx={floor_face['index']}, z={floor_face['z_mm']}, area={floor_face['area_mm2']:.1f}, normal={floor_face['normal']}")

# Vertical wall segments (cylinder/fillet surfaces)
walls = [f for f in faces if 'Cylinder' in f['type']]
print(f"\nVertical wall/corner faces:")
for w in walls:
    print(f"  idx={w['index']}, z={w['z_mm']}, area={w['area_mm2']:.1f}, normal={w['normal']}")

# Vertical planar wall faces
vert_planes = [f for f in faces if f['type']=='Plane' and abs(abs(f['normal'][0])-1)<0.1 and abs(abs(f['normal'][1])-1)<0.1]
print(f"\nVertical planar faces:")
for vp in vert_planes:
    print(f"  idx={vp['index']}, z={vp['z_mm']}, area={vp['area_mm2']:.1f}, normal={vp['normal']}")

# Top surface
print(f"\nTop surface: idx=13, area={faces[13]['area_mm2']}")

# List tools
print("\n=== AVAILABLE TOOLS ===")
tools = mb.list_library_tools(contains="TIW")
for t in tools:
    print(json.dumps(t))

import sys as _mbsys; _mbsys.path.insert(0, 'C:\\Users\\Nanja\\MachineBench\\machinebench\\bridge'); import mb_cam as mb
import json

# Add roughing tool: 12.7mm carbide 3-flute flat endmill (index 14)
r = mb.add_tool(
    "toollibraryroot://Local/TIW CNC Tool Library (4-28-26)",
    14
)
print("=== ROUGHING TOOL ===")
print(json.dumps(r))
ti_rough = r["document_tool_index"]

# Add finishing tool: 7.9375mm carbide 2-flute flat endmill (index 15)
r2 = mb.add_tool(
    "toollibraryroot://Local/TIW CNC Tool Library (4-28-26)",
    15
)
print("\n=== FINISHING TOOL ===")
print(json.dumps(r2))
ti_finish = r2["document_tool_index"]

# Create setup: WCS at top center, stock matches part exactly
setup_name = "Pocket-Mill"
result = mb.create_setup(
    body_index=0,
    wcs_origin="top center",
    stock={"mode": "relative", "side_mm": 0, "top_mm": 0, "bottom_mm": 0},
    name=setup_name
)
print("\n=== SETUP ===")
print(json.dumps(result))

import sys as _mbsys; _mbsys.path.insert(0, 'C:\\Users\\Nanja\\MachineBench\\machinebench\\bridge'); import mb_cam as mb
import json

# Roughing operation: adaptive2d on pocket floor face (idx=5)
# Using 12.7mm tool (document_tool_index=0)
# For 6061 Al, carbide endmill:
#   Surface speed Vc ~ 200 m/min => n = Vc*1000/(π*D) ≈ 5000 RPM -> use 5500
#   Feed per tooth fz ~ 0.15 mm/tooth => Fz*n*z = 0.15*5500*3 = 2475 mm/min -> round to 2500

ti_rough = 0
result = mb.add_operation(
    setup="Pocket-Mill",
    strategy="adaptive2d",
    tool=ti_rough,
    stepover_mm=5,          # ~40% of 12.7mm diameter - typical for adaptive
    stepdown_mm=5,          # 20mm depth / 4 passes
    geometry={"faces": [5], "type": "pocket"},
    feeds={
        "cutting_mm_min": 2500,
        "plunge_mm_min": 500,
        "ramp_mm_min": 800,
        "spindle_rpm": 5500
    },
    heights={
        "clearance_mm": 5,
        "retract_mm": 3
    },
    name="Pocket-Rough"
)
print("=== ROUGHING OPERATION ===")
print(json.dumps(result))

import sys as _mbsys; _mbsys.path.insert(0, 'C:\\Users\\Nanja\\MachineBench\\machinebench\\bridge'); import mb_cam as mb
import json

# Now add the finishing operations for the pocket
# Using 7.9375mm tool (document_tool_index=1)

# For 6061 Al, carbide endmill (finishing):
#   Surface speed Vc ~ 250 m/min => n = Vc*1000/(π*D) ≈ 10000 RPM -> use 10000
#   Feed per tooth fz ~ 0.05 mm/tooth => Fz*n*z = 0.05*10000*2 = 1000 mm/min

# Wall finishing: contour2d on the pocket floor face,
# side="AlwaysInsideSideType" means cut inside the boundary (the walls)
ti_finish = 1
result_walls = mb.add_operation(
    setup="Pocket-Mill",
    strategy="contour2d",
    tool=ti_finish,
    stepover_mm=0.5,          # light stock removal for finish
    stepdown_mm=10,           # one pass through the 20mm depth
    geometry={"faces": [5], "type": "contour", "loop": "OnlyOutsideLoops", "side": "AlwaysInsideSideType"},
    feeds={
        "cutting_mm_min": 1000,
        "plunge_mm_min": 300,
        "ramp_mm_min": 500,
        "spindle_rpm": 10000
    },
    heights={
        "clearance_mm": 5,
        "retract_mm": 3
    },
    name="Pocket-Finish-Walls"
)
print("=== WALL FINISH OPERATION ===")
print(json.dumps(result_walls))

# Floor finishing: pocket2d on the floor face
result_floor = mb.add_operation(
    setup="Pocket-Mill",
    strategy="pocket2d",
    tool=ti_finish,
    stepover_mm=1.5,          # ~20% of tool diameter for smooth finish
    stepdown_mm=1,            # shallow pass for good finish
    geometry={"faces": [5], "type": "pocket"},
    feeds={
        "cutting_mm_min": 1000,
        "plunge_mm_min": 300,
        "ramp_mm_min": 500,
        "spindle_rpm": 10000
    },
    heights={
        "clearance_mm": 5,
        "retract_mm": 3
    },
    name="Pocket-Finish-Floor"
)
print("\n=== FLOOR FINISH OPERATION ===")
print(json.dumps(result_floor))
